brief: A small-parts organizer with at least six separate bins.

requirements.requirement: Small-parts organizer with at least six separate bins
requirements.evidence: 6 hexagonal cells each fitted with compartmented bins: 3x hex-bin-full-div3 (9 compartments), 2x hex-bin-full-div2 (4 compartments), 1x hex-bin-third-div3 (3 compartments) = 16 separate compartments across 6 bin parts. Build meshClash clear.

finish.summary: Built 6-cell cluster (0,0; 1,0; 0,1; 0,-1; -1,0; -1,1) each with bins providing 16 total compartments, exceeding the 6-bin minimum. Joint bolts secure cluster, check_build clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
